dayOfTheWeek.textContent: What day would you like to simulate?

numberOfSlides.textContent: How many slides would you like to simulate?

startTime.textContent: What time would you like to start the simulation? (Simulation will run until 23:59:59) FORMAT: HH:MM:SS

avgSpeed.textContent: What would you assume the average speed a student is driving up the driveway? (MPH)

childsOnCampus.textContent: How many students on campus that day?

minHoursOnCampus.textContent: What is the minimum number of hours a student will spend on campus?

maxHoursOnCampus.textContent: What is the maximum number of hours a student will spend on campus?

studentsOnWeekends.textContent: Will students have classes on weekends?

avgSpentDays.textContent: What is the average amount of days a student will spend at school? FORMAT: 1-MAX or 7

mostPopulousDays.textContent: Pick two days most likely for a student to have classes. FORMAT: SUN, MON OPTIONS: SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT

variationInSchedule.textContent: How many students have a similar schedule? FORMAT: 1-100%

avgRadiiOfDriveCurves.textContent: What is the average radius of a curve in the driveway?

curvesInDriveway.textContent: How many curves are in the driveway?

rateOfAdvancement.textContent: What rate would you like to simulate? FORMAT: 1-10000x (in seconds per second)
